title: Have You Ever...?
description: Membicarakan pengalaman hidup dengan present perfect: bentuk have/has + past participle, ever/never, perbedaan been dan gone, serta beralih ke past simple untuk memberi detail.
objectives: Membentuk present perfect dengan have/has + past participle
Menghafal past participle kata kerja umum
Bertanya dan menjawab dengan Have you ever...? dan never
Membedakan been dan gone serta present perfect dan past simple

lessons.title: Present Perfect: Have/Has + Past Participle
lessons.summary: Membentuk present perfect untuk membicarakan pengalaman tanpa waktu yang spesifik.
objectives: Membentuk kalimat positif dan negatif present perfect
Memahami bahwa present perfect dipakai untuk pengalaman tanpa waktu yang spesifik
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Apa itu present perfect?
**Present perfect** dipakai untuk membicarakan **pengalaman** dalam hidup seseorang **sampai sekarang**, ketika **waktunya tidak penting** atau tidak disebutkan.

*I **have visited** Singapore three times.* (Saya sudah pernah mengunjungi Singapura tiga kali.)

Kita tidak tahu kapan — yang penting adalah **pengalamannya**.

### Pola
| Bentuk | Pola | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Positif | subject + **have/has** + past participle | *She **has worked** in a bank.* |
| Negatif | subject + **haven't/hasn't** + past participle | *We **haven't tried** Thai food.* |

| Subjek | have/has | Bentuk singkat |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I / you / we / they | have | I**'ve**, you**'ve**, we**'ve**, they**'ve** |
| he / she / it | has | he**'s**, she**'s**, it**'s** |

Hati-hati: **he's** bisa berarti *he is* atau *he has*. Lihat kata setelahnya: *He's tired* (is), *He's worked here* (has + participle).

### Past participle kata kerja beraturan
Untuk kata kerja beraturan, past participle **sama dengan** past simple (berakhiran **-ed**): *visit → visited → **visited***, *try → tried → **tried***, *study → studied → **studied***. Aturan ejaannya sama dengan Unit 2.

Kata kerja tidak beraturan punya bentuk sendiri (*eat → ate → **eaten***). Kamu akan mempelajarinya di Lesson 2.

### Perbedaan dengan bahasa Indonesia
Present perfect sering diterjemahkan dengan *sudah pernah* atau *pernah*:
- *I have cooked rendang.* = Saya pernah memasak rendang.
- *I haven't tried it.* = Saya belum pernah mencobanya.

### Jangan pakai waktu spesifik
Present perfect **tidak** dipakai dengan keterangan waktu lampau yang spesifik seperti *yesterday, last year, in 2019, two days ago*. Untuk itu, gunakan past simple (akan dibahas di Lesson 5).
- ✗ *I have visited Bali last year.*
- ✓ *I have visited Bali.* (pengalaman)
- ✓ *I visited Bali last year.* (waktu spesifik)

lessons.title: Past Participles of Common Verbs
lessons.summary: Menghafal past participle kata kerja tidak beraturan yang paling umum.
objectives: Menggunakan past participle kata kerja tidak beraturan yang umum
Membedakan past simple dan past participle (ate vs eaten)
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Tiga bentuk kata kerja
Setiap kata kerja punya tiga bentuk utama: **base form – past simple – past participle**. Untuk present perfect, kita butuh bentuk **ketiga**.

### Kelompok 1: past simple = past participle
Kabar baik: banyak kata kerja tidak beraturan punya bentuk 2 dan 3 yang **sama**.

| Base | Past simple | Past participle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buy | bought | **bought** |
| make | made | **made** |
| have | had | **had** |
| meet | met | **met** |
| lose | lost | **lost** |
| win | won | **won** |
| read | read /red/ | **read** /red/ |

### Kelompok 2: bentuk ketiga berbeda
Kelompok ini harus dihafal dengan teliti.

| Base | Past simple | Past participle |
| --- | --- | --- |
| be | was/were | **been** |
| go | went | **gone / been** |
| see | saw | **seen** |
| eat | ate | **eaten** |
| do | did | **done** |
| take | took | **taken** |
| write | wrote | **written** |
| give | gave | **given** |
| drive | drove | **driven** |
| ride | rode | **ridden** |
| fly | flew | **flown** |
| swim | swam | **swum** |
| break | broke | **broken** |

### Pola bunyi yang membantu
- Banyak participle berakhiran **-en/-n**: *eaten, taken, written, given, driven, ridden, broken, seen, flown*.
- Pola vokal **i – a – u**: *swim – swam – **swum***, *drink – drank – **drunk***, *begin – began – **begun***.

### Kesalahan paling umum
Memakai past simple setelah *have/has*:
- ✗ *I have ate sushi.* → ✓ *I have **eaten** sushi.*
- ✗ *She has went to Bali.* → ✓ *She has **been** to Bali.*
- ✗ *They have saw the film.* → ✓ *They have **seen** the film.*

### Tips menghafal
Ucapkan tiga bentuk dengan ritme: *see – saw – seen, eat – ate – eaten, write – wrote – written*. Buat kalimat tentang dirimu: *I've written a poem. I've eaten frog legs. I've never ridden a horse.*

lessons.title: Have You Ever...? Ever and Never
lessons.summary: Bertanya tentang pengalaman dengan Have you ever...? dan menjawab dengan never serta short answer.
objectives: Membuat pertanyaan Have/Has + subject + ever + past participle?
Menggunakan never dan short answers: Yes, I have / No, I haven't
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, coba latihan berbicara, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Have you ever...?
Untuk menanyakan pengalaman seseorang **sepanjang hidupnya**, gunakan **ever** (pernah):

**Have/Has + subject + ever + past participle?**

- *Have you **ever** eaten durian?* (Apakah kamu pernah makan durian?)
- *Has your sister **ever** ridden a horse?*

### Short answers
| Pertanyaan | Ya | Tidak |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Have you ever...? | Yes, I **have**. | No, I **haven't**. |
| Has she ever...? | Yes, she **has**. | No, she **hasn't**. |
| Have they ever...? | Yes, they **have**. | No, they **haven't**. |

✗ *Yes, I have eaten.* (terlalu panjang dan tidak alami sebagai short answer) — cukup *Yes, I have.*

### Never = tidak pernah
**Never** sudah bermakna negatif, jadi dipakai dengan **have/has** (positif), bukan *haven't*:
- ✓ *I've **never** ridden a horse.* (Saya belum pernah naik kuda.)
- ✗ *I haven't never ridden a horse.* (double negative)

Kamu juga bisa berkata *I haven't **ever**...*, tetapi *I've never...* jauh lebih umum.

### Posisi ever dan never
Keduanya diletakkan **di antara have/has dan past participle**:

| Benar | Salah |
| --- | --- |
| Have you **ever** tried it? | ✗ Have you tried ever it? |
| She has **never** flown. | ✗ She never has flown. |

### Ever hanya untuk pertanyaan
Dalam kalimat positif biasa, kita **tidak** memakai *ever*:
- ✗ *I have ever seen snow.*
- ✓ *I have seen snow.* atau ✓ *I've never seen snow.*

### Menambahkan jumlah
Untuk menjawab dengan detail jumlah: *once* (sekali), *twice* (dua kali), *three times*, *many times*.
- *Have you ever eaten sushi? — Yes, I have. I've eaten it **twice**.*

### Tips percakapan
*Have you ever...?* adalah cara bagus untuk memulai obrolan dan mengenal orang baru. Pertanyaan tentang tempat (*Have you ever been to...?*) akan dibahas di Lesson 4.

lessons.title: Been or Gone?
lessons.summary: Membedakan has been (sudah pergi dan kembali) dan has gone (sudah pergi dan belum kembali).
objectives: Menggunakan been to untuk pengalaman mengunjungi tempat
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Dua participle untuk go
Kata kerja **go** punya **dua** past participle dengan arti berbeda:

| Bentuk | Arti | Orangnya sekarang di mana? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **has/have been** to | pernah pergi **dan sudah kembali** | sudah kembali |
| **has/have gone** to | sudah pergi **dan belum kembali** | masih di sana / dalam perjalanan |

### Contoh
- *Rina **has been** to Japan.* → Rina pernah ke Jepang (sekarang sudah pulang). Ini **pengalaman**.
- *Rina **has gone** to Japan.* → Rina sudah berangkat ke Jepang (sekarang dia ada di sana, tidak di sini).

### Have you ever been to...?
Pertanyaan paling umum tentang pengalaman bepergian memakai **been**:
- *Have you ever **been to** Sulawesi?* — *Yes, I have. I've been there twice.*
- *I've never **been to** a K-pop concert.*

Perhatikan: dengan *there*, tidak ada *to*: ✓ *I've been **there***, ✗ *I've been to there*.

### Gone untuk menjelaskan ketidakhadiran
*Gone* sering dipakai untuk menjelaskan **mengapa seseorang tidak ada**:
- *A: Where's Pak Budi? B: He's **gone** to a meeting.* (Dia sedang rapat — tidak di sini.)
- *Sorry, the manager has **gone** home.* (Manajernya sudah pulang.)

### Tips: siapa yang bisa berkata "I've gone"?
Karena *gone* berarti orangnya **tidak di sini**, kita hampir tidak pernah berkata ✗ *I've gone to Bali* — kalau kamu sedang berbicara di sini, berarti kamu sudah kembali! Gunakan ✓ *I've been to Bali.*

### Ringkasan
| Situasi | Kalimat |
| --- | --- |
| pengalaman | *She's **been** to Paris three times.* |
| orangnya sedang pergi | *She's **gone** to Paris. She's coming back next month.* |
| tidak pernah | *She's never **been** to Paris.* |

lessons.title: Experiences, Achievements and Adventures
lessons.summary: Kosakata pengalaman dan petualangan, serta beralih dari present perfect ke past simple untuk memberi detail.
objectives: Menggunakan kosakata pengalaman, prestasi, dan petualangan
Memakai present perfect untuk pengalaman dan past simple untuk detail (kapan, di mana)
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, tulis tentang pengalamanmu, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Kosakata petualangan dan prestasi
| Pengalaman | Arti |
| --- | --- |
| climb a mountain | mendaki gunung |
| go scuba diving | menyelam (scuba) |
| go white-water rafting | arung jeram |
| ride a camel / an elephant | naik unta / gajah |
| run a marathon | lari maraton |
| win a competition / a prize | memenangkan lomba / hadiah |
| give a speech | berpidato |
| learn a musical instrument | belajar alat musik |
| try street food | mencoba jajanan kaki lima |

Kata sifat yang berguna: **brave** (berani), **scary** (menakutkan), **amazing** (luar biasa), **unforgettable** (tak terlupakan), **proud** (bangga).

### Present perfect → past simple
Dalam percakapan, kita biasanya **memulai** dengan present perfect (pengalaman umum), lalu **beralih** ke past simple untuk memberi **detail** (kapan, di mana, bagaimana).

*A: **Have** you ever **been** scuba diving?* (pengalaman — present perfect)
*B: Yes, I **have**. I **went** diving in Wakatobi two years ago.* (detail waktu — past simple)
*A: Wow! **Was** it scary?*
*B: A little, but it **was** amazing. I **saw** a turtle!*

### Aturan sederhana
| Present perfect | Past simple |
| --- | --- |
| waktu **tidak** disebutkan | waktu **disebutkan** |
| *I've climbed Mount Rinjani.* | *I climbed it **in 2019**.* |
| *Have you ever won a prize?* | *When did you win it?* |

Kata-kata seperti *yesterday, last year, in 2019, two years ago, when I was ten* → **selalu past simple**.

### Pertanyaan lanjutan
Setelah seseorang menjawab *Yes, I have*, tanyakan detail dengan **past simple**:
- *When **did** you **go**?*
- *Who **did** you **go** with?*
- *How **was** it?*
- *What **did** you **see**?*

✗ *When have you gone?* — salah, karena *when* menanyakan waktu spesifik.

### Menulis tentang pengalaman
Struktur paragraf sederhana: (1) kalimat present perfect tentang pengalaman, (2) detail past simple, (3) perasaan dengan was/were.

examples.en: I've climbed Mount Rinjani. I climbed it with my cousins in 2019.
examples.id: Saya pernah mendaki Gunung Rinjani. Saya mendakinya bersama sepupu pada 2019.

examples.id: Kapan kamu arung jeram? — Dua tahun lalu.

examples.id: Itu hari paling tak terlupakan dalam hidupku.

Finishing the marathon was a big achievement.

grammar.pattern: Have you ever + participle? → Yes, I have. + past simple detail
grammar.example: Have you ever ridden a camel? Yes, I have. I rode one in Egypt.

grammar.pattern: When / Where / Who + did + subject + base verb?

mistakes.wrong: I have climbed Mount Rinjani in 2018.
When have you been to Bali?
mistakes.right: When did you go to Bali?
mistakes.why: When menanyakan waktu spesifik, jadi memakai past simple.

mistakes.wrong: Yes, I have. I have gone diving last year.
mistakes.right: Yes, I have. I went diving last year.
mistakes.why: Detail dengan last year memakai past simple.

sections.summary: Mulai dengan **present perfect** untuk pengalaman (*Have you ever...? / I've...*), lalu beralih ke **past simple** untuk detail (*I went there last year. It was amazing.*). Gunakan kosakata petualangan dan prestasi: *climb, go scuba diving, win a prize, brave, unforgettable*.

questions.misconception: Memilih patient (sabar) yang tidak cocok dengan konteks.

questions.prompt: Choose the best follow-up question.

dialogue.speaker: Wira
dialogue.text: Have you ever been scuba diving?

questions.explanation: Pertanyaan tentang waktu spesifik memakai past simple: When did you go?

questions.prompt: Write about two interesting experiences in your life. For each one, start with the present perfect (I've...), then give details in the past simple (when, where, who with) and say how you felt.
questions.explanation: Contoh struktur: I've climbed a volcano. I climbed it in 2022 with my friends. It was scary but amazing.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct forms.
questions.text: I ___ to Japan. I ___ there in 2019 with my family.
questions.explanation: Kalimat pertama = pengalaman tanpa waktu → have been. Kalimat kedua ada waktu spesifik (in 2019) → went.

questions.prompt: Complete the dialogue with one word in the first gap and the correct form of win in the second gap.
questions.text: A: Have you ever won a prize? B: Yes, I ___. I ___ (win) a photography competition last year.
questions.explanation: Short answer: Yes, I have. Detail dengan last year → past simple: won.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have climbed Mount Rinjani in 2018.
questions.explanation: In 2018 adalah waktu spesifik, jadi memakai past simple: I climbed...

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the correct option: Have you ever ___ a camel?
unitTestQuestions.explanation: ride – rode – ridden. Setelah have, pakai past participle.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Complete with the past participle of the verb in brackets.
unitTestQuestions.text: My grandmother is 80, but she has never ___ (fly) in a plane.

unitTestQuestions.sentence: I have went to Bandung many times.
answers: I have been to Bandung many times.
I've been to Bandung many times.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Went adalah past simple. Untuk pengalaman pergi dan kembali, pakai have been to.

dialogue.speaker: Visitor
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is Mr. Hasan in his office?

options: No, sorry. He's gone to a meeting.
No, sorry. He's been to a meeting.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Pak Hasan sedang tidak ada (belum kembali) → He's gone to a meeting.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Match each verb with its past participle.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: break – broke – broken, give – gave – given, do – did – done, lose – lost – lost.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a question.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Has + subjek + ever + past participle + objek.

answers: She has never been to Bali.
She hasn't ever been to Bali.
She has not ever been to Bali.
She has not been to Bali.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Belum pernah ke = has never been to.
